declared_scope: The v0.12 parent stack plus a single reversible sysctl: vm.vfs_cache_pressure=50 (channel: memory). Autonomously proposed; one knob added, nothing removed.
hypothesis: Halving vfs_cache_pressure (100->50) makes the kernel retain dentry/inode cache longer, which can lower cold-start and memory-refault cost on repeated access. Risk: on tight RAM it trades file-cache for metadata cache; the memory + cold-start channels adjudicate.
rollback_method: Restores the prior vm.vfs_cache_pressure value captured at apply time, then delegates the rest of the revert to the v0.12 preset undo; harness reverts at run end.
